question: A triangle can be constructed from three given sides when the sum of any two sides is:
urdu_translation: three given sides سے triangle تب construct ہو سکتا ہے جب any two sides کا sum کیا ہو؟
A: Greater than the third side / third side سے greater
B: Less than the third side / third side سے less
C: Equal to the third side / third side کے equal
correct_answer: A | Greater than the third side / third side سے greater

question: The construction using three given side lengths is called:
urdu_translation: three given side lengths والی construction کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟

question: Two given sides and their included angle describe which construction case?
urdu_translation: two given sides اور included angle کون سا construction case describe کرتے ہیں؟

question: A perpendicular bisector cuts a line segment at:
urdu_translation: perpendicular bisector line segment کو کہاں cut کرتا ہے؟
A: Its midpoint at 90° / اس کے midpoint پر 90°
B: One endpoint at 45° / one endpoint پر 45°
C: Any point at 60° / any point پر 60°
D: Its midpoint parallel to it / midpoint پر parallel
correct_answer: A | Its midpoint at 90° / اس کے midpoint پر 90°

question: A median of a triangle joins a vertex to the:
urdu_translation: triangle کی median vertex کو کس سے join کرتی ہے؟
A: Midpoint of the opposite side / opposite side کے midpoint
D: Midpoint of an adjacent side only / صرف adjacent side کے midpoint
correct_answer: A | Midpoint of the opposite side / opposite side کے midpoint

question: The locus of points at a fixed distance from a fixed point is a:
urdu_translation: fixed point سے fixed distance پر points کا locus کیا ہے؟

question: The locus of points equidistant from two fixed points is the:
urdu_translation: two fixed points سے equidistant points کا locus کیا ہے؟
A: Circle through the points / points سے passing circle

question: The locus of points equidistant from two intersecting lines is formed by their:
urdu_translation: two intersecting lines سے equidistant points کا locus کس سے بنتا ہے؟

question: Which set of lengths can form a triangle?
urdu_translation: کون سا lengths کا set triangle بنا سکتا ہے؟

question: In an SSS construction, the third vertex is located by:
urdu_translation: SSS construction میں third vertex کیسے locate کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Drawing one parallel line / one parallel line draw کرکے
B: Finding a midpoint only / صرف midpoint find کرکے
C: Intersecting two arcs / two arcs intersect کرکے
D: Drawing a histogram / histogram draw کرکے
correct_answer: C | Intersecting two arcs / two arcs intersect کرکے

question: In a SAS construction, the included angle is the angle:
urdu_translation: SAS construction میں included angle کون سی angle ہے؟
A: Between the two given sides / two given sides کے درمیان
B: Opposite both given sides / دونوں given sides کے opposite
C: Outside the triangle / triangle کے outside
correct_answer: A | Between the two given sides / two given sides کے درمیان

question: The ambiguous triangle-construction case is generally:
urdu_translation: ambiguous triangle-construction case generally کون سا ہے؟

question: In an acute-angle SSA construction, two triangles are possible when the relevant arc:
urdu_translation: acute-angle SSA construction میں two triangles کب possible ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Does not meet the ray / ray کو meet نہ کرے
B: Intersects the ray at two points / ray کو two points پر intersect کرے
C: Touches the ray at one point / ray کو one point پر touch کرے
D: Has zero radius / zero radius رکھتا ہو
correct_answer: B | Intersects the ray at two points / ray کو two points پر intersect کرے

question: In an acute-angle SSA construction, one right triangle is obtained when the arc:
urdu_translation: acute-angle SSA construction میں one right triangle کب بنتا ہے؟
A: Touches the ray at one point / ray کو one point پر touch کرے
B: Cuts the ray at two points / ray کو two points پر cut کرے
C: Does not reach the ray / ray تک نہ پہنچے
D: Is centred at the vertex only / صرف vertex پر centred ہو
correct_answer: A | Touches the ray at one point / ray کو one point پر touch کرے

question: When the given angle opposite a given side is obtuse, the construction allows:
urdu_translation: given side کے opposite angle obtuse ہو تو construction کتنے triangles allow کرتی ہے؟
A: Always two triangles / ہمیشہ two triangles
B: At most one triangle / maximum one triangle
C: Exactly three triangles / exactly three triangles
D: Infinitely many triangles / infinitely many triangles
correct_answer: B | At most one triangle / maximum one triangle

question: Three or more lines meeting at one point are called:
urdu_translation: three یا more lines one point پر meet کریں تو انہیں کیا کہتے ہیں؟

question: An angle bisector divides an angle into:
urdu_translation: angle bisector angle کو کس میں divide کرتی ہے؟
A: Three equal angles / three equal angles
B: One acute and one obtuse angle necessarily / ضروری one acute اور one obtuse
C: Two equal angles / two equal angles
D: Two unequal angles / two unequal angles
correct_answer: C | Two equal angles / two equal angles

question: An altitude of a triangle is drawn from a vertex perpendicular to the:
urdu_translation: triangle کی altitude vertex سے perpendicular کس طرف draw ہوتی ہے؟
A: Adjacent side only / صرف adjacent side
C: Angle bisector only / صرف angle bisector
D: Opposite side or its extension / opposite side یا اس کی extension
correct_answer: D | Opposite side or its extension / opposite side یا اس کی extension

question: The locus of points at a fixed distance from a fixed line consists of:
urdu_translation: fixed line سے fixed distance پر points کا locus کس پر مشتمل ہوتا ہے؟
B: One perpendicular line / one perpendicular line
C: Two parallel lines / two parallel lines
D: Two intersecting lines / two intersecting lines
correct_answer: C | Two parallel lines / two parallel lines

question: The locus of points at a fixed distance from a finite line segment has a:
urdu_translation: finite line segment سے fixed distance والے points کا locus کس shape کا ہوتا ہے؟
A: Perfect square only / صرف perfect square

question: A point at the intersection of two loci:
urdu_translation: two loci کے intersection پر point کیا satisfy کرتا ہے؟
A: Only the first condition / صرف first condition
B: Only the second condition / صرف second condition
C: Both given conditions / دونوں given conditions
correct_answer: C | Both given conditions / دونوں given conditions

question: A point 3.1 cm from A and equidistant from A and B lies at the intersection of a circle centred at A and the:
urdu_translation: point A سے 3.1 cm اور A,B سے equidistant ہو تو وہ A-centred circle اور کس کے intersection پر ہوگا؟
A: Angle bisector of A / A کی angle bisector
C: Parallel through B / B سے parallel
D: Perpendicular bisector of AB / AB کی perpendicular bisector
correct_answer: D | Perpendicular bisector of AB / AB کی perpendicular bisector

question: A fire hydrant equally accessible from two water sources should be placed on their:
urdu_translation: two water sources سے equally accessible fire hydrant کہاں place ہونا چاہیے؟
B: Joining segment only / صرف joining segment
C: Angle bisector of a third point / third point کی angle bisector
D: Circle centred at either source only / صرف کسی one source-centred circle

question: A quarantine boundary exactly 10 km from an infection source is represented by a:
urdu_translation: infection source سے exactly 10 km quarantine boundary کس سے represent ہوتی ہے؟
A: Circle of radius 10 km / radius 10 km کا circle
B: Line of length 10 km / length 10 km کی line
D: Pair of parallel lines / pair of parallel lines
correct_answer: A | Circle of radius 10 km / radius 10 km کا circle

question: In the textbook SSA example with DE=6 cm and angle D=30°, the perpendicular distance from E to ray DX is 3 cm. If EF=3.6 cm, the number of possible triangles is:

question: Can sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 14 cm form a triangle?
urdu_translation: کیا sides 6 cm، 8 cm اور 14 cm triangle بنا سکتی ہیں؟
B: Yes, every three lengths form a triangle / ہاں، ہر three lengths triangle بناتی ہیں

question: A point equidistant from L and M and also equidistant from lines LM and LN is found by intersecting the:
urdu_translation: L اور M سے equidistant اور lines LM اور LN سے بھی equidistant point کن loci کے intersection سے ملتا ہے؟
A: Two circles centred at L / L-centred two circles
B: Two parallels to LM / LM کے two parallels
C: Median and altitude of any triangle / any triangle کی median اور altitude

correct_answer: D | Perpendicular bisector of LM and angle bisector of ∠MLN / LM کی perpendicular bisector اور ∠MLN کی angle bisector

question: Inside a rectangle, points less than 30 m from vertex C and farther than 25 m from side AB lie in the intersection of:
urdu_translation: rectangle کے اندر vertex C سے 30 m سے less اور side AB سے 25 m سے farther points کس intersection میں ہوں گے؟
A: Outside the circle and on AB / circle کے outside اور AB پر

correct_answer: C | Inside a circle centred at C and beyond a parallel to AB / C-centred circle کے اندر اور AB کے parallel boundary سے beyond

question: Two cities A and B are 8 km apart. A location 6.8 km from A and 7.3 km from B is found by intersecting:
urdu_translation: cities A اور B 8 km apart ہیں۔ A سے 6.8 km اور B سے 7.3 km location کس intersection سے ملے گی؟
